rules.source_fidelity: all stable topic answers derive from audited Current/later-stage hooks; current-year exact wording is excluded
rules.material_identity: normalized exact material → deterministic fnv1a64-utf16 identity
rules.material_family_identity: source_basis-scoped family; same family is never FRESH after prior exposure
rules.changed_context: requires different exact material_identity; same family may be CHANGED_CONTEXT but not FRESH

official_corroboration_note: Broad stable Marxism/history/ethics constructs were spot-checked against authoritative public sources before this bank was materialized; current-year exact exam wording remains source-gated.

defects_found: 8 stress variants lacked an explicit competing principle and therefore did not truly test discrimination
formulation retrieval prompts used an underspecified generic topic cue; repaired to reveal the intended topic by design
task identity did not carry exact material identity, so reused source hooks could allow same/near-derived material to be mislabeled fresh
invariants: Prompt IDs are unique and have exactly one answer-key row
PRINCIPLE_RETRIEVAL does not reveal the exact expected topic string
STRESS_VARIANT carries an explicit competing principle
FORMULATION_RETRIEVAL reveals the topic intentionally because formulation, not identification, is the tested construct
same task after answer reveal is never fresh transfer
FRESH evidence must use an unseen exact material_identity and an unseen material_family_id; CHANGED_CONTEXT must use a different exact material_identity

findings: Dedicated Material Segmentation coverage was absent.
The 72-task bank had zero Mao and zero Xi prompts; this could falsely imply whole-subject Analysis coverage.
Mao was added only from stable Current chapter compression; no annual exactness was invented.
Xi was added only for structural identification/skeleton; current-year exact wording remains blocked.

provenance_repair.reason: legacy 72 prompts had answer-key source_hook but no prompt-level source_basis; normalized without changing task semantics

material_identity_repair.reason: task_id/source_basis alone could not prove fresh material when the same source hook was reused across task roles
